notes.title: Update - Galleries of photos - Place your own photos
notes.content:
Now you can place folders of your own photos in the Photos folder. Each subfolder will correspond to a gallery.  The only thing you need to do is to create folders and place images in these subfolders. You can replace the provided examples if you wish.  

The current example includes 3 folders with different images. 

The folder is:  [i]GreatPaintingsVR_Data\StreamingAssets\Photos[/i]

notes.title: DLC - Great Paintings VR - Donation
